resources.string: User-configured call routing with a bounded safety policy.
Reference build • Test only while parked
Automatically request the target call route
Only this explicitly selected device may receive a bounded reassertion during the 4-second startup window. Leave unset for a single initial attempt.
Requires MANAGE_ONGOING_CALLS authorization through ADB. No root, accessibility, default-dialer replacement, or always-on foreground service is used.

First leave automation off. While parked, make an ordinary non-emergency call, leave it on the initial route, and press Route now. This performs one request and bypasses only the projection-state gate. Emergency and device-identity checks still apply.

No internet, audio recording, contacts, or call-log access. Exported app logs exclude phone numbers and use salted device aliases. Unknown/emergency calls and multiple-call sessions are left to Android.
